title: HydroJEV: A one-second, training-free screen for cyber-attack and fault attribution in water distribution networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.02048v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a SCADA alarm is raised in a water distribution network, operators must decide quickly whether it reflects a cyberattack, a physical fault, a normal transient or a faulty sensor. Supervised classifiers need labelled incidents that utilities rarely have, and frontier large language models (LLMs) take tens of seconds per decision. We tested whether Jev, a training-free model that returns class probabilities in about one second, can serve as the first tier of this triage. On a four-class cause-attribution benchmark built on the C-Town network in EPANET, Jev was compared with a hand-written rule tree, a supervised classifier and seven cloud LLMs on identical evidence in four sealed, pre-registered rounds. With only a label-free prior correction, Jev matched the rule tree (macro-F1 0.62-0.64 against 0.56-0.61 in distribution) and exceeded the supervised classifier by 0.36-0.42 on event subtypes absent from its labels, in all four rounds,

translated_title: HydroJEV：一种面向供水网络网络攻击与故障归因的一秒级、免训练筛选方法
translated_abstract: 当供水网络中触发SCADA警报时，操作人员必须迅速判断该警报反映的是网络攻击、物理故障、正常瞬态波动还是传感器故障。监督式分类器需要标注事件数据，而公用事业公司很少拥有这类数据；前沿大语言模型（LLM）每次决策则需要数十秒。我们测试了Jev——一种能在约一秒内返回类别概率的免训练模型——能否作为这一分诊流程的第一层级。在一个基于EPANET中C-Town网络构建的四分类原因归因基准上，Jev在四个密封、预注册的轮次中，于相同证据条件下与人工编写的规则树、监督式分类器以及七个云端LLM进行了比较。仅通过一次无标签的先验校正，Jev在全部四个轮次中均达到了与规则树相当的水平（macro-F1为0.62-0.64，分布上优于0.56-0.61），并且在监督式分类器标签中未出现的事件子类型上以0.36-0.42的幅度超越了后者。
tldr: HydroJEV验证了免训练模型Jev可在约一秒内对供水网络SCADA警报进行网络攻击与故障归因筛选，其性能与规则树相当，并在未见事件子类型上大幅超越监督分类器，可作为警报分诊的第一层级。
en_tdlr: HydroJEV shows that the training-free model Jev, which returns class probabilities in about one second, can serve as the first tier of SCADA alarm triage in water distribution networks, matching a rule tree and surpassing supervised classifiers by 0.36-0.42 macro-F1 on unseen event subtypes.
